x.name: Gabe Pereyra
x.bio: building @harvey with my bud @winstonweinberg

tweets.text:
Very cool work from @rikiyatakehi and @lateinteraction's lab at MIT.

They show GPT-6 Astra can read the weights of a Qwen model and update them directly to improve performance.

In early results MATH-500 jumped from 7.9% to 48.1% and it even wrote a Breakout policy from scratch.

The two research questions I'm most excited about are whether this scales from billion-parameter models to trillion-parameter models and which stages of a modern post-training pipeline it could replace.

Today the largest open models are post-trained in several stages. Kimi K3 and DeepSeek-V4 train RL specialists and distill them into one model while GLM-5 and MiniMax-M3 run a chain of RL stages.

We're proud to support Omar's lab and to be working with them to scale this up to larger models and test it on LAB.

Great new work from the @EngramLab team! Co-optimizing not just the tools an agent uses but the context it operates in is a great direction for recurring knowledge bases which are common in legal.

Their figure game also continues to be some of the best in the business! https://t.co/u5di3Ad0Wq
